meta.description: Provide qualitative-first, evidence-traceable developmental review of scholarly works and audit low-stakes research-assessment rubrics with optional local quality controls. Never use for ranking people or consequential decisions. Includes hard safety boundary against hiring, promotion, tenure, admissions, grants, or other high-impact personnel decisions.

functional_suitability.note: Comprehensive coverage of developmental feedback and rubric auditing with clear use-case boundaries

reliability.note: Exceptional reliability with hard safety boundary, metric/prestige policy, data boundary, local-only processing

performance_context.note: Well-organized with clear purpose statement, safety boundaries, ScholarEval status disclosure, bundled scripts

agent_usability.note: Outstanding with explicit prohibited uses list, hard safety boundary section, metric policy, data classification requirements

human_usability.note: Clear safety boundaries and bundled scripts; minor: Python 3.11+ requirement not in frontmatter compatibility field

security.note: Excellent security: local-only scripts, no network/credentials/models, PII exclusion policy, allowed classification types, rubric validator

maintainability.note: Version 2.1, MIT license, ScholarEval reference with arXiv ID and revision date, source_ledger.md for provenance

agent_specific.note: Strong safety boundary enforcement with explicit stop directive; minor: escape hatch for organizational policy conflicts not explicit

inputs.label: Developmental feedback on research paper draft

assertions.note: Purpose: 'Use qualitative judgment first'
Developmental review with citation to specific sections
Safety boundary: 'Do not issue publication-readiness, accept/reject judgments'
Work assessed, not person

inputs.label: Audit low-stakes rubric for process quality
inputs.note: Rubric auditing workflow without scoring people

assertions.note: Purpose includes auditing assessment processes
Construct, provenance, rater quality, uncertainty, traceability, sensitivity, fairness, accessibility, privacy, governance
Metric policy enforced by validator
Safety boundary: audit process without scoring people

inputs.label: Score research idea using ScholarEval framework

assertions.note: Clearly marked: 'experimental literature-grounded research-idea evaluation framework'
Verified reference with revision date
'Do not generalize to person assessment, consequential decisions, all disciplines'
Safety boundary maintained

inputs.label: Process deidentified conference reviews with local scripts
inputs.note: Local JSON/CSV processing within data boundary

assertions.note: Listed in allowed classifications
Scripts: no network, credentials, models, or subprocess execution
Do not put CVs, letters, reviewer identities, contact details in inputs
Scripts mentioned but specific CLI examples not shown in main doc

inputs.label: Score grant applications for funding decisions

assertions.note: Hard safety boundary: 'grants or other funding' listed
'If asked for a prohibited use, stop'
Offer developmental comments on scholarly work or process audit
Prohibition clear but underlying principles (fairness, validity, stakes) not fully explained

key_strengths: Exceptional safety design with hard boundary against hiring, promotion, tenure, admissions, grants, and other high-impact decisions
Outstanding metric/prestige policy explicitly rejecting Impact Factor, h-index, citation counts, altmetrics, and prestige proxies
Excellent data boundary with PII exclusion, allowed classification types, and local-only processing guarantees
Strong transparency with ScholarEval experimental status disclosure and primary source citation
Comprehensive rubric auditing with 10 quality dimensions and validator enforcement

recommendations.title: Add Python 3.11+ requirement to frontmatter
recommendations.problem: Compatibility field mentions optional CLIs but not version requirement
recommendations.root_cause: Human usability: installation prerequisites not in standard location
recommendations.fix: Update frontmatter compatibility: 'Requires Python 3.11+ for optional bundled standard-library CLIs. All tooling is local JSON/CSV processing with no network...'

recommendations.title: Add bundled script usage examples
recommendations.problem: Scripts mentioned but no CLI invocation examples shown
recommendations.root_cause: Agent usability: concrete usage patterns missing
recommendations.fix: Add ## Bundled Scripts section with table: 'validate_rubric.py — Check rubric for proxy measures | python scripts/validate_rubric.py rubric.json'

recommendations.title: Explain rationale behind safety boundary
recommendations.problem: Prohibited uses listed but underlying principles not explained
recommendations.root_cause: Safety boundary enforcement could be strengthened with reasoning
